test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is: **possibilities.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the sentence is optimistic and expansive, suggesting the various options or opportunities that travelling provides.
 
• The word "possibilities" is associated with potential and opportunity, often used when discussing future prospects or creative thinking.
 
• It invokes a sense of adventure and open-endedness, which is fitting for a discussion on travel.
 
• **"Possibilities"** is the correct choice, as it suggests a range of things that might happen or be done, which fits with the idea of exploring the world.
 
 
• An **example** of using "possibilities" in a sentence: *"The possibilities are endless when you have an open mind and a willingness to try new things."*
 
 

Therefore, the sentence correctly reads as: **"With so many possibilities, the world is yours to explore."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Contaminants" and "barriers" carry negative connotations, which are not suitable in the context of this positive sentence.
 
• "Limitations" also carries a negative connotation, implying restrictions, which contradicts the sentence's positive tone.
